prediction.title: Fight Markets
prediction.subtitle: Buy a share in the fighter you think wins. The price you pay is the odds — and you trade against other players, never the house.
prediction.loadFailed: Could not load the card. Please try again.
prediction.emptyCard: No markets are open yet. Check back soon.
prediction.noOffers: Nobody is offering this side yet
prediction.howPays: One share pays {share} ETB if your fighter wins, and nothing if they lose. What you pay for it is the chance the market gives them: your price, out of {share} ETB, is the percentage.
prediction.howRests: Your order rests in the book until another player takes the other side. It may not fill straight away — that is normal in a young market, not an error — and you can cancel it any time until it does.
prediction.howHold: A position is held until the result. There is no cash-out in this version.
prediction.closedNotice: Trading has closed. Positions are held until the result is confirmed.
prediction.resolvingNotice: The result is under review. Payouts are released when the review window ends.
prediction.settledNotice: {winner} won. Winning shares paid {share} ETB each; losing shares paid nothing.
prediction.voidedNotice: This market was voided. Every position was refunded at what it cost.
prediction.depthEmpty: No orders resting on this side yet.
prediction.ticketPriceHint: Whole birr, {min} to {max}, in 1 ETB steps.
prediction.ticketPriceMeans: You are saying this fighter wins {percent}% of the time.
prediction.tradingClosed: This market is not taking orders.
prediction.restingNotice: This order rests in the book until another player takes the other side at a matching price. It may not fill straight away — an unfilled order is normal, not a failure — and you can cancel it any time until it fills.
prediction.holdNotice: There is no cash-out. Once filled, shares are held until the result: {share} ETB each if your fighter wins, nothing if they lose.
prediction.signInPrompt: Sign in to trade this market.
prediction.resultAllResting: Order placed. All {shares} shares are resting in the book — nobody has taken the other side yet.
prediction.resultPartial: {filled} shares filled. {resting} are resting in the book until someone takes the other side.
prediction.ordersNote: These are waiting for someone to take the other side. Cancel one and the money comes straight back.

prediction.positionNote: Held until the result. There is no cash-out in this version.
